summary: Enhance your skills with our Energy Management Training Course. Learn effective strategies to optimize energy use and drive sustainability in your organization.
lede: Energy management involves identifying energy costs and waste, then assessing opportunities to improve efficiency and value. For operations, facilities, sustainability, finance and procurement professionals, this course develops practical skills to map energy costs, compare investment options through lifecycle and financial analysis, and build evidence-based business cases that communicate savings, risks and project value.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for a diverse group of professionals across the public sector, NGOs, and private enterprises, who play a role in energy efficiency and financial decision-making within their organizations.
audience: Building managers and real estate teams
modules: Energy as a Strategic Business Asset
Energy Management in Public and NGO Sectors
Communicating Energy Value and Securing Buy-In
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites are needed, but a basic understanding of business finance and energy concepts will be beneficial. This course is suitable for anyone involved in or responsible for energy decision-making and financial planning within their organization.
